title: Detection and Prevention of Casino-related Crimes
what_it_is: Detection and Prevention of Casino-related Crimes

sections.label: Casino crime and regulation
sections.summary: Casino crimes fell 58% from 299 to 126 cases between 2010 and 2018, with Police and CRA managing law-and-order concerns.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Between 2010 and 2018, the annual number of casino crimes fell by 58%, from 299 to 126 cases.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police and the Casino Regulatory Authority (CRA) actively manage the law-and-order concerns relating to the casinos.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To prevent infiltration of criminal elements into the casinos, CRA licenses casino employees and subjects them to stringent checks.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs has put in place tough penalties for casino-related crimes and the Police adopt a zero-tolerance approach towards such crimes.

sections.label: Nature of casino offences
sections.summary: The vast majority of crimes committed in the casinos are mostly opportunistic and petty in nature.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If we look at the pattern of all the offences, the cases that I talked about, the vast majority of crimes committed in the casinos are mostly opportunistic and petty in nature.

sections.label: Syndicate-related casino cases
sections.summary: Since 2010, fewer than 20 cases in total were related to syndicates, with amounts between $14,000 and $1.3 million.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Since 2010, ever since we started the tracking when the operations commenced, there have been fewer than 20 in total that are related to syndicates.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If you look at the amounts of money involved, they were between $14,000 to $1.3 million.

sections.label: Operators' interest against crime
sections.summary: Operators have a fiduciary interest and are minded to work with the Police to stamp out possible infiltration of organised crime.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In this instance, the operators obviously have an interest.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: They have fiduciary interest and so they are minded to work with the Police to stamp out the possible infiltration of organised crime.
